name: adu-smart-campus-site
description: Abu Dhabi University Smart Digital Campus - PRE-BUILT static site. The repository root is the deployable artifact: index.html, assets/, images/, videos/ and api-data/ are already built and committed. On static hosting nothing needs installing or building - point the web root here and serve it. This file exists so hosts that auto-detect a Node project (Hostinger, Netlify, Vercel, Render) find a no-op build at the root instead of descending into src-app/ and running the source build, which writes to src-app/dist - a directory that is gitignored, is not served, and lacks the baked api-data the site needs. If the host is configured as a Node application instead, `npm start` runs server.js, a zero-dependency static server for this same directory.

scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then(({existsSync})=>{if(!existsSync('index.html'))throw new Error('index.html is missing from the repository root - the committed build is incomplete');console.log('Nothing to build. This repository root IS the pre-built site; serve it as static files.')})"
